scope: Post-open mechanism attribution using only already opened reported geometry. It compares the thirteen supplied nine-camera calibrations that failed the v208 absolute K16 reference gate with the thirteen virtual-ring nine-camera rigs that passed v209. It reads no Case 5 density, observation, reconstruction, residual, or metric array and is not a fresh external gate.
scientific_question: Can one fixed geometry-only low-mode observability metric strictly separate every passing virtual-ring nine-camera rig from every failing supplied nine-camera calibration without using field truth, observations, reconstruction outcomes, or fitted thresholds?

supplied_nine_failing.source: The calibration roster and all-nine reported geometry sealed by the v207 release and independently used by v208.
supplied_nine_failing.reference_outcome: 0/546 strict cells and 0/13 complete calibration groups at zero-start CGLS K16 in v208.

virtual_ring_nine_passing.source: The first-nine camera IDs of each frozen virtual-ring order in v209, with the same clean reported geometry generator.
virtual_ring_nine_passing.reference_outcome: 546/546 strict cells and 13/13 complete rig groups at zero-start CGLS K16 in v209.

virtual_ring_twelve_diagnostic.source: The complete frozen virtual-ring orders in v209.
virtual_ring_twelve_diagnostic.reference_outcome: 546/546 strict cells and 13/13 complete rig groups at zero-start CGLS K16 in v209.

fixed_probe_subspace.construction: Tensor products of sin(pi*k*i/(n-1)) on each field axis. Set the outer boundary to zero, subtract each mode's supported-interior mean, set the outer boundary to zero again, then compute a reduced QR basis with deterministic first-largest-entry sign fixing.

unique_primary.name: trace_normalized_low64_gram_spectral_floor
unique_primary.response: For each geometry, apply its frozen exact reported forward to all 64 fixed basis fields, producing M with one row per scalar observation and one column per basis field.
unique_primary.metric: The smallest nonnegative eigenvalue of the symmetrized G_normalized. Eigenvalues below -1e-10 times the largest eigenvalue invalidate execution; values in the floating negative roundoff interval are clipped to zero only after that check.
unique_primary.scale_invariance: Trace normalization removes global operator scale and observation-row-count scale. No per-family or per-rig fit is permitted.
unique_primary.strict_separation_gate: min(metric over all 13 virtual-ring nine-camera rigs) must be strictly greater than max(metric over all 13 supplied nine-camera calibrations).
unique_primary.pairwise_audit: Also report the fraction of all 169 virtual-versus-supplied pairs for which the virtual metric is greater, with exact ties counted as one half. Strict separation is equivalent to all 169 strict comparisons passing.

preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.normalized_spectral_condition: largest normalized Gram eigenvalue divided by the maximum of the spectral floor and 64*machine epsilon
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.effective_rank_fraction: exp(-sum p_i log p_i)/64 for normalized nonnegative Gram eigenvalues
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.ray_transverse_sensitivity_floor: smallest eigenvalue of 3*mean(I-d*d^T)/trace(mean(I-d*d^T)) over every valid reported ray direction
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.ray_transverse_sensitivity_condition: largest divided by smallest normalized transverse-sensitivity eigenvalue with a 3*machine-epsilon numerical denominator floor
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.virtual_twelve_camera_metrics: reported only to audit the already rejected simple cardinality explanation; they cannot replace the virtual-nine primary family

execution_contract.camera_permutation_rule: Reversing each camera roster may only permute response rows and ray directions; every scalar metric must agree within 1e-12.

independent_validation.implementation: A second program must independently parse supplied calibrations, reconstruct virtual geometry without importing the formal runner, rebuild the raw sine span with a different orthonormalization route, recompute response spectra and ray sensitivity, verify all 39 rows and all family summaries, and confirm parent/input trees are unchanged.

decision_order: Any parent mismatch, input or source drift, prohibited scientific-array read, non-finite value, rank loss, negative-eigenvalue violation, camera-permutation failure, formal-independent mismatch, or output mutation gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_GEOMETRY_OBSERVABILITY_EXECUTION_V210.

If every one of the 169 virtual-nine versus supplied-nine primary comparisons is strictly greater, conclude PASS_GEOMETRY_ONLY_LOW_MODE_OBSERVABILITY_STRICTLY_SEPARATES_CASE5_REFERENCE_V210. This supports a geometry-conditioning explanation on already opened synthetic data only.

Otherwise, if the virtual-nine primary median is strictly greater than the supplied-nine median and the pairwise superiority fraction is greater than 0.5, conclude PARTIAL_OVERLAPPING_GEOMETRY_ONLY_OBSERVABILITY_EVIDENCE_V210. The metric moves in the expected direction but does not identify reference adequacy without overlap.
Otherwise conclude FAIL_GEOMETRY_ONLY_LOW_MODE_OBSERVABILITY_DOES_NOT_EXPLAIN_CASE5_REFERENCE_V210 and close this fixed low-mode spectral-floor explanation.
Diagnostics and the virtual-twelve family may never replace the unique primary or upgrade a partial/negative outcome.
